title: 8-Figure founder shares his hiring secret
transcript: When I hired my director of operations, he had worked for Nike. I purposely hired somebody outside of e learning coaching world. He was coming in and being like, dude, you gotta change this, you gotta change that, you gotta do this differently. And I had literally never thought of some of the stuff that he was talking about. And I never would have because nobody gets trained on that stuff that's inside of our industry. There's nothing that will kill a business faster than you being the smartest person in your company. So if your knowledge base in your company is capped with you and everybody below you is taking their orders from you, you will never be able to grow. You will always be bottlenecked by you.
